topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning objectives, lecture framing, and the foundational framework of cancer hallmarks across tumor progression.

topics.label: Growth Signaling Autonomy and Pathway Deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic signaling pathways and mutations enable cancer cells to achieve growth signal autonomy and resist inhibitory signals.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Leukemias and Carcinomas
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells disrupt normal maturation pathways and maintain proliferative precursor states across hematologic and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis and p53 Regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the mechanisms through which cancer cells evade programmed cell death via alterations in p53 and the Bcl-2 family.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells bypass the Hayflick limit via telomerase reactivation while avoiding stress-induced senescence mechanisms.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolic Reprogramming and Epigenetic Interactions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the shift to complex cancer hallmarks by analyzing the Warburg effect, metabolic rewiring, and the reciprocal regulation between oncometabolites and the epigenome.

topics.label: Angiogenesis in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the requirement, timing, and molecular balance of pro- and anti-angiogenic factors supporting tumor vascularization.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Clinical Monitoring of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the multi-step cascade of metastatic dissemination, systemic circulation, seed-and-soil compatibility, and diagnostic approaches.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Concluding Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with closing remarks on cancer hallmark integration and instructions for future practicals.
